meaning.en: (obsolete) To lay a tax upon; to assess.
meaning.vi: (lỗi thời) Để đánh thuế; để đánh giá.

sentences.en: The elves waged a fierce battle, but without sess. Arthas defeated the Ranger General Sylvanas Windrunner and transformed her into a banshee as punishment for her opposition to him.
